title: The Yellow door of the shed
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：yellow　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 yellow 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the warden wrote of ① a yellow door of the shed in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② yellower than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the yellow ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the yellowest door of the shed anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too yellow to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the yellow ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a yellow page of the book, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as yellow as the page of the book they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was yellow or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something yellow, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite yellow; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the yellow ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, on the same day, she wrote of another yellow door of the shed in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ yellower than anybody had expected. ⑩ The yellowest page of the book in the whole centre, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the yellow ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 黄色（前置定语 a yellow door of the shed：1958 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件黄色的黄门）
B. adj. 黄色／发黄（比较级 yellower than：文中两处，一处比棚屋的黄门，一处比预想）
C. adj. 黄色／发黄（最高级 the yellowest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 黄色（表语 too yellow to do：母亲觉得它太黄色，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 发黄（前置定语 a yellow page of the book：叔叔把整件事称作一桩发黄的一页）
F. adj. 发黄（同级比较 as yellow as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩书里发黄的一页相比）
G. adj. 发黄（后置定语 something yellow：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 发黄（受程度副词修饰 quite yellow：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a yellow door of the shed
the yellowest door of the shed anybody
a yellow page of the book
The yellowest page of the book in

answers.why: yellow 意为“黄色”，1958 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件黄色的黄门”，此处作前置定语 a yellow door of the shed。
yellow 意为“黄色”，此处用比较级 yellower than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
yellow 意为“黄色”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最黄色的一件，故用最高级 the yellowest door of the shed。
yellow 意为“黄色”，母亲认为这件东西“太黄色了，谁也用不上”，too yellow to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
yellow 意为“发黄”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩发黄的一页”，此处作前置定语 a yellow page of the book。
yellow 意为“发黄”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩书里发黄的一页一样发黄”，同级比较用 as yellow as。
yellow 意为“发黄”，登记册上那半行字要的是“发黄的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something yellow。
yellow 意为“发黄”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当发黄”，quite 修饰原级 yellow。
yellow 意为“发黄”，1968 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要发黄”，故用比较级 yellower than。
yellow 意为“发黄”，母亲 1970 年说的是“整个社区中心里最发黄的那一桩”，故用最高级 the yellowest page of the book。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件黄色的黄门。（a yellow door of the shed）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更黄色。（yellower than …）
母亲觉得它太黄色，谁也用不上。（too yellow to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩发黄的一页。（a yellow page of the book）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩书里发黄的一页一样发黄。（as yellow as …）
到了 1965 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件发黄的东西。（something yellow）
answers: In 1958 the warden wrote of a yellow door of the shed in the register.
Everybody said it was yellower than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too yellow to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a yellow page of the book.
He said nobody would call it as yellow as the page of the book they had once had.
By 1965 the register asked for nothing but something yellow.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 yellow 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the warden wrote of a yellow door of the shed in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the yellowest door of the shed in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too yellow to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a yellow page of the book, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite yellow, and everybody laughed.
The yellow ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
